finalists.label: Twin Anemia-Polycythemia Sequence
finalists.why: The evidence of MCA-PSV 50.9 cm/s and a thickened, echogenic placenta for twin 2 strongly supports this diagnosis.

finalists.label: Growth Restriction
finalists.why: The repeated findings of twin 2 having an estimated fetal weight less than the 5th percentile support this diagnosis.

finalists.label: Chromosomal Abnormality
finalists.why: Although there is no direct evidence for this, the normal chromosomal microarray does not entirely rule it out, but it is less likely given the other findings.

frontier_selector.why: The specific evidence of elevated MCA-PSV in twin 2 and the improvement in amniotic fluid from anhydramnios to oligohydramnios, followed by normalization, points towards Twin Anemia-Polycythemia Sequence as the most decisive diagnosis.

support_spans: Twin 2: estimated fetal weight 1128 g (<5th centile), normal amniotic fluid, normal umbilical-artery Dopplers, and MCA-PSV 50.9 cm/s (1.3 MoM)
amniotic fluid improved from anhydramnios to oligohydramnios (maximum vertical pocket 1.9 cm)
